description: This Java class 'RequestWrapper' extends HttpServletRequestWrapper to provide custom request handling, including buffering the request body for multiple reads and providing custom implementations for getReader() and getInputStream().

classes.name: RequestWrapper
classes.description: A custom HttpServletRequestWrapper that buffers the request body for repeated reads and provides custom implementations of getReader() and getInputStream().

methods.name: getReader
methods.description: Returns a BufferedReader that reads from the buffered request bytes.

methods.name: getInputStream
methods.description: Returns a ServletInputStream that reads from the buffered request bytes.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Reads and caches the request body bytes from the original request input stream.
